purpose: real Alpha-classification recovery of the c904d4cc claims whose alpha_classifier call was lost to the audit-concurrency defect
original_run_access: read-only; file hashes recorded before derivation and compared after

request_budget.counting_rule: every request that reaches the audited transport counts, whether it later succeeds or fails; a resume counts requests already audited in the execution directory
request_budget.expected_real_sends: 955 to 973 (identical-input claims may be served by the semantic cache; a cache hit never reserves budget)

request_config.client_level_retries_source: hardcoded 0 by build_server_week2_llm_gateway; also verified on the wire per batch (x-stainless-retry-count)
request_config.application_level_retries_source: COMQUTOR_WEEK2_LLM_MAX_RETRIES=0 exported by the launcher; preflight refuses anything else
request_config.timeout_source: COMQUTOR_WEEK2_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=45 exported by the launcher (NOT the .env value); preflight checks the gateway, and every batch's audited request is checked for x-stainless-read-timeout=45.0

request_shape.note: the original run's shape (no max_tokens, no thinking/reasoning field); verified on the wire for every audited request, and these env vars must be absent from the launch shell: COMQUTOR_WEEK2_ALPHA_CLASSIFIER_MAX_TOKENS, COMQUTOR_WEEK2_LLM_BASE_URL

order_note: the 19 analytical SUPPORTS claims go first purely as an ORDER; the scope stays all 973. The first 4 are the real parallel-configuration gate: all four must be protocol-complete (valid selection or valid NONE) with the right claim identity on the wire, else the run stops before anything else is scheduled.

classification_outcome_rules.valid_none: a COMPLETED classification; never retried to try to obtain a match
classification_outcome_rules.unknown_inflight: request audited but no response saved; never auto-resent; reported as unknown

task_isolation.mechanism: TaskAllowlistGateway refuses any other task before it is forwarded; the executor also stops if a batch's audited requests contain another task
task_isolation.direction_task: evidence_stance_classifier is not sent; its needed requests, independent budget and reuse check are written to evidence_stance_followup_manifest.json and need their own authorization

stop_rules.local_audit_failure: the request/response audit could not be persisted
stop_rules.task_isolation_violation: a second task was attempted or audited
stop_rules.identity_failure: an audited request carries no claim id
stop_rules.config_failure: an audited request's model, read-timeout or retry-count differs from the frozen values
stop_rules.stage_a_gate_failed: any of the first 4 claims is not protocol-complete with correct identity (evaluated from the audit log, so it also holds on resume)
stop_rules.semantics: a stop prevents any NEW batch from being scheduled; the batch already in flight finishes and each of its calls is individually finalized -- in-flight calls are never claimed to be cancelled

checkpoints.crash_recovery: claim state is reconciled from the audit log, so a crash between a response and its batch checkpoint loses nothing; a claim audited but never saved is rebuilt offline from the audited decision
checkpoints.resume: launch_real_recovery.sh with EXECUTION_ID and RECOVERY_MAX_CALLS = 973 minus requests already audited

authorization.note: the value is derived from the frozen plan; changing the plan, cap, model, timeout, concurrency or task list changes it

required_environment.COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL: exported; database name must end in _test
